PhotoAnalysis.description:
Flat Pydantic schema enforced on Gemini's structured JSON output.

This model is passed directly to `response_schema` in the GenAI SDK config.
It MUST remain flat (no nested BaseModel children) to avoid 400 errors
from the Gemini structured output API.

The boolean forensic flags provide deterministic, machine-readable damage
indicators. The forensic_narrative provides the adjuster-facing prose.
The LLM fills this schema — it never touches downstream math.

alternative_explanation.description: Alternative explanation or cause of the visible anomalies if confidence is not 100% (e.g. manufacturing defect, weathering, blistering, mechanical damage).
alternative_explanation.title: Alternative Explanation

crease_marks.description: True if wind-lifted shingle crease lines are visible.
crease_marks.title: Crease Marks

damage_detected.description: True if any hail or wind damage is visible in the photo.
damage_detected.title: Damage Detected

damage_type.description: Primary damage classification: hail, wind, mechanical, aging, or none.

exposed_fiberglass.description: True if the fiberglass mat is exposed on any shingle.
exposed_fiberglass.title: Exposed Fiberglass

filename.description: Original filename of the analyzed photo.
filename.title: Filename

forensic_narrative.description: 2-3 sentence technical forensic description of visible damage indicators. Written as expert testimony suitable for an insurance adjuster review.
forensic_narrative.title: Forensic Narrative

granule_depletion_pattern.description: Step 1 observation: Pattern of granule loss (e.g. 'localized_circular_impact', 'widespread_uniform_weathering', 'mechanical_scuff', 'none').
granule_depletion_pattern.title: Granule Depletion Pattern

granule_loss.description: True if significant granule displacement is visible on shingle surfaces.
granule_loss.title: Granule Loss

hail_hits_visible.description: True if distinct circular hail impact marks are visible on shingles.
hail_hits_visible.title: Hail Hits Visible

impact_bruise_present.description: Step 3 observation: True if a soft, indented impact bruise characteristic of functional hail damage is present.
impact_bruise_present.title: Impact Bruise Present

severity.description: Severity of the detected damage: none, minor, moderate, or severe.

substrate_condition.description: Step 2 observation: Condition of the underlying asphalt / fiberglass substrate mat (e.g. 'intact', 'exposed_fiberglass', 'fractured_mat', 'surface_crease').
substrate_condition.title: Substrate Condition

PhotoAnalysis.title: PhotoAnalysis
